title: Settings
subtitle: Your name and preferences, household-wide settings, members, and backups.

nickname.title: Your name
nickname.description: A short nickname shown in ownership labels and owner pickers. Leave it blank to use your full name ({{displayName}}).

householdName.title: Household name
householdName.description: Shown to anyone you invite and in restore confirmations. Any member can change it.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language used for menus, labels, and date / number formatting.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Choose a light or dark colour scheme. Your choice follows you across devices.

carryoverDate.title: Carry-over date
carryoverDate.description: When you copy last month's figure into a new snapshot, this sets the statement date it starts with. You can still change the date before saving.

modes.end_of_month_after_last_snapshot: End of month after last snapshot

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Net worth is reported in this currency.
currency.multiDescription: Hold positions in other currencies and enter a monthly exchange rate for each.

fx.title: Exchange rates
fx.description: One rate per month per currency — reporting-currency units per 1 unit of the foreign currency (the month-end rate). Later months reuse the most recent rate until you enter a new one.
fx.disabledHint: Exchange rates only apply once multi-currency tracking is on.

inflation.title: Inflation
inflation.description: Used to estimate how long your investments would last if income stopped (fund resilience). Set an assumed annual rate, and optionally enter the actual annualized (year-on-year) figure each month on the Inflation Rates page — the estimate averages the last 12 months when available.
inflation.empty: No monthly figures entered — the assumed rate is used.

inflationRatesPage.title: Inflation Rates
inflationRatesPage.subtitle: Enter the actual annualized (year-on-year) inflation figure for any month you have it. Months you leave blank fall back to the assumed rate on the Settings page.

invite.title: Invite someone to your household
invite.description: They'll receive an email with a sign-in link.
invite.emailFailed: Invite created — the email couldn't be sent. Share the link below instead.

reactivation.title: Reactivate a household member
reactivation.description: Members restored from a backup can't sign in until you give them a set-password link. This lists anyone waiting for one.
reactivation.empty: No members are waiting to be reactivated.
reactivation.hint: Share this link with them out-of-band. It works once and expires; don't reuse it.

data.title: Backup
data.description: Download your entire household as a single file. Keep it somewhere safe, or use it to move your data to another device.

fidelity.label: What to include
fidelity.fullHint: Includes items you've deleted, so the copy is exact.
fidelity.compactedHint: A clean copy without anything you've deleted.

data.exportError: Couldn't prepare your backup. Please try again.
data.largeNote: Large households may take a moment.

restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.description: Replace everything in this household with the contents of a backup file. This is how you move your data onto a new device.
restore.chooseHint: Nothing changes yet — you'll see what the file holds first.
restore.previewError: That file couldn't be read as a backup. Please try another.
restore.olderVersionNote: This backup was made by an older version of Balances. It'll be brought up to date automatically when you restore — nothing for you to do.
restore.stakesEmpty: This household is empty, so nothing will be lost.
restore.stakesWarning: This will permanently erase the {{count}} item currently in this household and replace it with the backup. This can't be undone.
restore.stakesWarning_other: This will permanently erase the {{count}} items currently in this household and replace them with the backup. This can't be undone.
restore.ack: I understand this replaces everything in this household.
restore.erasePrompt: Type {{word}} to confirm you want to erase and replace your data.
restore.dontClose: Restoring your data — please don't close this window.

erase.title: Delete this household
erase.description: Permanently delete this household and everything in it — every position, snapshot, transaction, and member account. This cannot be undone.
erase.exportFirst: Consider downloading a backup first — once deleted, this data can't be recovered.
erase.confirmPrompt: Type your household's name, “{{household}}”, to confirm.
erase.failed: Couldn't delete this household. Please try again.
